name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or capability
labels: enhancement
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Proposal
      description: Describe the feature or enhancement.
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: rationale
    attributes:
      label: Rationale
      description: Why is this needed and what problem does it address?
      required: true
